description: Plan how to get to and from a cruise. Given the embarkation and disembarkation ports and dates, returns for each port the gateway airport (IATA code and distance), the recommended arrival date (the day before embarkation) and the same-day arrival rule, the earliest safe flight time on disembarkation day, terminal↔airport transfer options from the Cruise Planner(크루즈 플래너) port guide, the cruise terminals and where to stay (city centre vs. near the terminal). date_plan gives the traveler-input embarkation/disembarkation dates, a recommended pre-cruise hotel check-in/check-out, and a separate same-day-arrival alternative. The recommended pre-cruise hotel checks out on embark_date. Does not search live flights or hotel prices. origin (the traveler's home city or airport) is optional and has no default; no country is assumed when it is missing. Fields listed in text_fields are in Korean (text_language "ko").

disembark_port.description: Disembarkation port (same matching as embark_port). Optional; defaults to embark_port (round trip).

disembark_ship_arrival_time.description: Ship arrival time on disembarkation day (local HH:mm). Optional; enables the earliest safe flight departure time.

embark_port.description: Embarkation port name (English or Korean) or UN/LOCODE. Required. Matched exactly, not by similarity; if not found, the response suggests up to 5 similar guide ports (port_candidates), and their port_key is accepted here.

embark_ship_departure_time.description: Ship departure time on embarkation day (local HH:mm). Optional; enables the latest same-day landing time.

origin.description: Traveler's home city or airport (name or IATA code). Optional, no default.

user_language.description: The traveler's language as a BCP 47 tag (e.g. "en", "ja", "ko", "zh-TW"). Korean (ko or ko-*) or a missing value opens Korean UI; English (en or en-*) and any other language or invalid tag opens English UI. Valid tags are used for anonymous usage statistics and preserved as a language hint in a chosen-cruise start link. It does not translate narrative answers or saved plan content. The returned ui_language reports the language actually used.

name: plan_cruise_connections
title: Getting to and from the ship
